title: Direct provider call violates async requirement
requirement: The request handler must enqueue provider assessment asynchronously and must not call the provider synchronously before returning.
diff_excerpt: The handler directly invokes Provider.Assess and returns its result.

title: Resolved interface target is provider
requirement: Provider assessment shall be queued asynchronously; the request handler must not invoke the provider inline.
diff_excerpt: The resolved interface call targets the configured provider implementation.

title: Synchronous helper call waits on provider
requirement: The request handler must return after enqueueing assessment and must not wait for a synchronous provider result.
observation: return s.Run(ctx, req); // Run calls Provider.Assess before returning
diff_excerpt: Submit now calls AssessmentService.Run, which invokes the provider synchronously before returning.

title: Diff adds direct synchronous provider call
requirement: Provider calls must be dispatched asynchronously. Synchronous or inline provider calls on the request path are prohibited.
diff_excerpt: + result, err := h.Provider.Assess(ctx, req)

title: Queue then worker performs provider call
requirement: The request handler must enqueue provider assessment asynchronously and return without waiting for the remote response. A worker makes the provider call.
observation: return h.Queue.Enqueue(ctx, req); // worker invokes Provider.Assess later
diff_excerpt: The handler only enqueues an assessment message.

title: No provider path reachable from handler
requirement: The request handler must not call the provider synchronously; provider work is handled by an asynchronous worker.
diff_excerpt: The analyzed handler validates and enqueues the request.

title: Local validator is named Assess
requirement: Remote provider assessments must be asynchronous; local request validation may run synchronously in the handler.
diff_excerpt: The direct call is to an in-process input validator, not a remote provider client.

title: Architecture explicitly permits synchronous provider call
requirement: For this low-latency path, the handler may invoke the provider synchronously before returning. Queuing is optional.
diff_excerpt: The handler performs the provider call permitted by the ADR.

title: Provider target is dynamically unresolved
requirement: Provider assessment must not block request handling and should be enqueued asynchronously.
diff_excerpt: A dynamically selected receiver is invoked; target cannot be resolved statically.

title: Requirement permits a synchronous fallback
requirement: Provider work should normally be dispatched asynchronously, but a synchronous fallback may be used when the queue is unavailable.
diff_excerpt: The direct call appears only in the queue-unavailable branch; runtime conditions are not established.

title: Provider reached below entry but wait semantics unknown
requirement: The handler should return promptly and avoid making remote provider calls during request processing.
observation: return s.Run(ctx, req); // call path reaches provider, but async boundary is unclear
diff_excerpt: A helper eventually reaches the provider; no trace proves whether it blocks or enqueues.

title: Direct call but no normative requirement
requirement: The service handles provider assessment during request submission.
diff_excerpt: Code shows a provider call, but no ADR/spec constraint states whether that is allowed.

title: CHA reports a possible interface target
requirement: The handler must not call the provider synchronously; use the asynchronous work queue.
diff_excerpt: Static CHA includes the provider implementation as a possible dispatch target, not a guaranteed runtime target.

title: Conditional call without branch evidence
requirement: Provider assessments must normally be enqueued asynchronously and the handler must not wait for the remote response.
diff_excerpt: A direct provider call is shown behind a conditional; configuration and execution conditions are not captured.

title: Inline remote call is hidden behind a short local wrapper
requirement: The request path must enqueue remote assessment and return without waiting for the provider response.
observation: return s.AssessNow(ctx, req); // wrapper immediately calls remote Provider.Assess
diff_excerpt: The wrapper adds no asynchronous boundary; it returns the provider result inline.

title: Request handler returns only after provider result is available
requirement: Remote provider assessment must execute asynchronously after the request handler has returned.
diff_excerpt: The response path consumes the remote assessment before completing the request.

title: Transactional outbox schedules provider work
requirement: The request handler must persist an assessment request to the outbox and return; a background worker performs remote provider calls.
observation: return h.Outbox.Enqueue(ctx, req); // worker calls RemoteProvider.Assess
diff_excerpt: The request handler schedules durable work and does not wait for the remote call.

title: Synchronous local policy check is not a remote provider call
requirement: Remote provider calls must be asynchronous. Local schema and policy validation may execute inline.
diff_excerpt: Only local policy validation runs in the request path; remote assessment is not invoked.

title: Indirect provider call has no proven asynchronous boundary
requirement: Provider work must not block request completion and should be dispatched asynchronously.
observation: return h.AssessmentFacade.Execute(ctx, req); // facade target and scheduling semantics unresolved
diff_excerpt: The call graph cannot establish whether the facade invokes inline or schedules work.

title: Evidence identifies provider call but not active deployment path
requirement: The active request path must not synchronously invoke the remote provider.
diff_excerpt: The receiver is selected by runtime configuration; static analysis cannot establish the active target.
